name: trace_call_path
description: Resolve start and optional goal symbols or addresses to canonical procedure entries, then trace direct callers or callees until the graph is exhausted or the goal is reached. Results use canonical addresses; Evidence preserves supplied selectors. Returns visited nodes, direct-call edges, a shortest traversal path, provider failures, and residual unknowns; unresolved indirect calls remain unknown.

__schema0.description: A starting procedure symbol or address

__schema1.description: An optional destination procedure symbol or address

direction.description: Direction in which to traverse or compare relationships.

goal.description: An optional destination procedure symbol or address

start.description: A starting procedure symbol or address
